what.text: This page follows refugees from Sierra Leone living in Ghana, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 91 Sierra Leonean refugees in Ghana, 1.0% of all refugees from Sierra Leone.
France hosts the most Sierra Leonean refugees, followed by Guinea, Germany and Greece.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sierra Leone in every year from 1991 to 2001, with the RUF and AFRC among the opponents.
The main year of displacement in the data, 2002, comes just after that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 4316, at the end of 2002, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Ghana.
These are year-end totals for Ghana only, reported to UNHCR.
